intent_contract.text: 좀 더 역동적인 모습으로 국군 홍보 포스터 느낌으로 프롬프트 설계하고 그려줘.

Keep the prior reference adult and special-warfare identity while replacing the calm training pause with a visibly dynamic forward action and a polished Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional-poster treatment.

Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait as a modern special-warfare operator. Preserve her eye aperture and spacing, long oval face, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, adult age, and long dark wavy hair. She powers forward through a rain-wet obstacle course, one boot striking a shallow puddle into a sharp arc of spray as her torso leans into the stride. Her matte helmet, communications headset, olive-and-charcoal combat uniform, plate carrier, and pouches move with believable weight; a compact carbine stays controlled across her chest on its sling, muzzle angled down. Frame her full body from a low three-quarter angle with strong diagonal perspective, while the upper sky remains a clean field reserved for later campaign typography. A rising sun breaks through cool storm haze behind her, producing crisp rim light, airborne droplets, and a restrained red-blue tonal counterpoint. Her focused gaze reaches beyond the camera toward the objective. The result reads as premium national-defense recruitment campaign key art: energetic, disciplined, capable, and resolutely forward-moving.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.

render_gates.description: The subject and any relationship counterpart are unmistakably adult fictional people, while the requested identity, role, and styling remain intact.
A calm low-expression baseline remains immediately legible without becoming hostile, frightened, vacant, or broadly cheerful.
The quiet support action and localized warmth clearly point to one identifiable trusted adult counterpart rather than everyone in the scene.
One practical target-directed act is concretely readable and is not replaced by an adjective, gaze, costume, role, or caring prop alone.
Exactly one restrained facial, hand, or shoulder region softens toward the trusted counterpart while the rest of the composed baseline remains stable.
An already-visible helpful consequence belongs to the same counterpart, such as relief, restored comfort, or resumed activity.
Stable composure, selective warmth, practical support, and its same-target consequence coexist in one still without an abrupt personality reversal.
Hair, eyes, costume, gender, role, posture, and muted or cool styling remain optional; none is accepted as archetype proof without the relationship behavior.

invisible three-dimensional field revealed only through material consequences
same measurable consequence across several surfaces
native material identity preserved under one shared transform

obligation.composition_instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Within every affected region, preserve the source surface's native material identity, local texture, thickness, lighting, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion while the chosen rule changes its coordinates or correspondence; the error must follow the three-dimensional scene rather than cut and move a flat image plane. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.

render_gates.description: Lens, sensor, exposure, and image surface read as clean photographic capture rather than a damaged display or file.
The scene establishes an immediately familiar and physically coherent baseline before the contradiction is inspected.
Exactly one spatial, temporal, causal, optical, or topological invariant supplies the governing error rule.
At least three affected surfaces repeat the same measurable displacement, lag, dependency, correspondence, or recursion.

Within every affected region, native material identity, local texture, lighting, thickness, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion remain coherent under the shared rule; source pixels or facial texture are not stamped onto unrelated surfaces.
Unaffected anatomy, objects, perspective, lighting, and materials remain internally coherent and physically plausible.

The contradiction appears at the deliberately selected reveal strength, immediate or delayed, while remaining clearly authored, subordinate to one inferable world rule, and distinguishable from generic image failure.

A screen effect, split seam, collage, visible translucent shell, enclosing splash ring, portal, magical rift, flat image-plane slice, particle dissolve, or random anomaly stack does not substitute for the repeated world rule.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can state the single failed world rule and point to at least three separated instances that share its same measurable relation; merely saying that something looks wrong fails.
An isolated malformed hand or face, fused object, broken texture or text, accidental reflection or shadow mismatch, or other familiar synthesis defect does not carry the reality-error concept.
